mostWorthwhile.text: Making the Moon from an impact was the most worthwhile passage: it connected a surprising combination to debris gathering into a companion that reflects sunlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive inspections of the rocky world, Light, Sun and Void were frustrating because each returned an empty compatibility list.

surprise.text: Earth in the surrounding deep produced wandering sky stones, which then struck the world and formed the Moon.

arbitrary.text: Casting Earth into the cosmic deep to make sky stones was not a route I had anticipated; I followed the compatibility information rather than understanding its purpose beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see more combinations that connect the creation story to how a world works, though I hope for fewer uninformative inspections.
